title: fix(cli): `os validate` runs the four authoring lints `os build` runs (#3782)
body:
Closes #3782.

## The bug is bigger than the issue

The issue frames this as a problem #3760 *will* create once `flow-runas-unscoped` becomes blocking. It was already a problem: `lintFlowPatterns` is one of **four** authoring lints wired into `compile.ts` only, and **two of the other three already failed the build** before #3760 landed.

| Lint | Emits `severity: 'error'` | `os build` | `os validate` (before) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lintAutonumberFormats` | **yes** | ✓ | — |
| `lintViewRefs` (#2554) | **yes** | ✓ | — |
| `lintFlowPatterns` (#1874) | **yes**, since #3784 | ✓ | — |
| `lintLivenessProperties` | no | ✓ | — |

Reproduced verbatim against `examples/app-todo` — one autonumber field interpolating a nonexistent field, with `validate.ts` at its pre-fix state:

```
os validate  →  ✓ Validation passed (46ms)
os build     →  ✗ Autonumber format validation failed (1 issue)
```

## Why it drifted

Every *other* gate on both commands is a shared `@objectstack/lint` import. These four are CLI-local `../utils/lint-*` modules that only `compile.ts` ever imported — so "add a gate to the build" never implied "add it to validate", and nothing anywhere asserted otherwise.

## The fix

**1. Wiring** — `validate.ts` runs all four, mirroring `compile.ts`'s per-lint severity handling: `error` → exit 1, everything else → advisory print, and into the `warnings` array under `--json`.

**2. The actual fix for the class of bug** — a source-level test asserts every `lintFoo(`/`validateFoo(` call site in `compile.ts` also appears in `validate.ts`, failing with the list of missing gates and how to fix it. A `BUILD_ONLY_GATES` allowlist exists for checks that genuinely cannot run without emitting an artifact; it is empty, and that is the healthy state.

**3. The #3760 seam** — both surfaces filter on `FlowLintFinding.severity`, so promoting a rule gates them together.

## The headline case, verified end-to-end

This branch was rebased **after** #3784 landed. The seam needed no follow-up wiring — flipping `TaskReminderFlow`'s `runAs: 'system'` → `'user'` (a user-less schedule trigger) now fails **both**:

```
os validate → ✗ Authoring lint failed (1 issue)
              • flow 'task_reminder' · runAs: schedule-triggered flow runs as
                `runAs:'user'`, but a schedule run has no trigger user …
                rule: flow-runas-unscoped
os build    → ✗ Flow authoring check failed (1 error)
                rule: flow-runas-unscoped
```

Before this PR that flow failed `os build` and passed `os validate` — the exact trap #3782 reports. Fault reverted; `app-todo` validates clean.

## Behavior change

`os validate` now surfaces every rule these four lints carry, including advisory ones, so existing projects may see new warnings. **Only** `error` findings change the exit code — and any project they now fail was already failing `os build`. This is the issue's anticipated "surfaces all its rules there for the first time".

## Verification

- **Gate proven red before green** — temporarily unwired `lintViewRefs` from `validate.ts`; the parity test failed with `os build runs 1 gate(s) that os validate does not: lintViewRefs`. Restored.
- **A/B on the autonumber trap** — with `validate.ts` at `origin/main` → validate passes, build fails; with this branch → both fail identically.
- **Headline flow case** — proven post-rebase, above.
- `pnpm build` (full, no `OS_SKIP_DTS` — the real typecheck gate): 71/71
- `pnpm test`: 132/132 tasks; `@objectstack/cli` 675 tests across 67 files post-rebase
- `os validate` clean on all three examples (app-todo, app-crm, app-showcase)
- `pnpm lint`, `check:role-word`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:org-identifier`: pass
- `pnpm docs:build`: pass (docs table + sample output updated; its "will not fail `os build`" claim is now true)

## Note on the rebase

The predicted conflict with #3784 materialized in `lint-flow-patterns.ts` (both PRs added `severity?`). Resolved in favor of #3784's wording, with a sentence added noting both surfaces filter on it.
